question: Can the R44CC family be sealed as a formula-level polynomial reduction from GRAPH_3_COLORING to GLOBAL_TRANSPORT_EXISTENCE, with recovery and verification using only the constructed sibling CNFs?
reduction_claim_to_test: G is properly 3-colorable iff there exists a global signed transport A_G -> B_G under the frozen R44CC transport predicate
required_proof_obligations: recover all 3-variable blocks from A_G and B_G alone
discover exactly three local transport candidates per block from formulas alone
derive each edge compatibility relation from clauses alone
verify each recovered edge relation is exact ternary inequality
verify every proper 3-coloring induces one accepted global transport assignment
verify every accepted global transport assignment decodes to a proper 3-coloring
verify representation size and construction are polynomial
verify no graph coloring truth labels are supplied to transport recovery
not_claimed: TRUMP cannot have an additional polynomial invariant
the full TRUMP algorithm is complete or polynomial
